scientific_limitations: Stationary arcsine measure on an invariant diagonal curve; infinitesimal off-diagonal variational dynamics only. Does not assert attraction of arbitrary matrices. Gaussian limit uses an ergodic reverse-martingale CLT; finite verifications do not prove infinite statements.
title: A unique transverse fluctuation cancellation in a matrix logistic map
